job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer with 412 years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in building and deploying production-grade GenAI solutions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI Agents, Python, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
The role involves designing end-to-end GenAI solutions, developing RAG pipelines and AI agents, integrating models such as OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, and building AI services using Python and FastAPI/Flask.
The candidate will work with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search and deploy scalable AI applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Responsibilities also include LLM evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, security, responsible AI, performance optimization, and taking GenAI solutions from POC to production.
